crosswalk.cardinality: one per explicitly completed supported event
crosswalk.reverse: index retains event ID, original seconds, outcome and source selector
crosswalk.source: typedEvent.event + completed eventDispositions + exact PREMIS event
crosswalk.uncertainty: source qualification retained; only exact recorded seconds converted

crosswalk.reverse: original name and class plus unique PREMIS identity
crosswalk.source: original PREMIS agentType/agentName + exact source agent-document selector

crosswalk.cardinality: one document and every referenced event/agent/object
crosswalk.reverse: exact retained byte hash and XML identity path
crosswalk.uncertainty: XML validity is not historical fact

rules.activity: Explicitly completed supported PREMIS event -> Activity; original event IRI retained. Other dispositions remain sidecars.
rules.agent: Explicit person -> Person; organization -> Group; exact name -> Name. Software stays typed PREMIS/Stream-only.
rules.identity: Original PREMIS event and agent IRIs remain stable. The derived PREMIS document identity uses its immutable complete-byte hash.
rules.premis: The correspondence index links every emitted event/agent to the exact complete packaged PREMIS DigitalObject and unique XML identifier with original source selectors. Structured PREMIS data is not forced into a linguistic carrier relationship.
rules.provenance: Every emitted JSON leaf retains its mapping rule, exact PREMIS path and source-selector set; source-authority evidence remains in the literal nested package.
rules.roles: Opaque original agent/object role identifiers remain exact sidecar relationships. No carried_out_by, used_specific_object, rights or custodial role is inferred.
rules.time: Exact recorded eventDateTime -> point TimeSpan with equal outer bounds. Never publication, file or export time.
rules.type: Original PREMIS event type retained as a profile-local Type; no inferred Creation, Acquisition or TransferOfCustody.
